mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 thousand units signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 250 (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation, triggering aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes that compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 250.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) signals overheating economy with aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST > 1200 and CPIAUCSL > 250.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve implements accommodative monetary policy to stimulate job growth, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) reading below 105 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 105.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5%), economic overheating increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annual growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous slowing employment growth (PAYEMS < 100 thousand jobs) and restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) signals labor market cooling with tight policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market cooling with tight policy
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS < 100 and FEDFUNDS > 2.5.
